status: experimental hypothesis; no performance result yet
goal: Test a fresh source-only 15K selector against a fresh matched random15K control and original Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct.

controls.random: uniform broad prepared source pool after shared deduplication, benchmark/source-heldout, prompt-capacity and reserved-probe exclusions; not restricted to complete short traces and not uniform over untouched original100K
controls.random_training_truncation: declared prefix truncation only in token cache; original exports unchanged; no invented EOS; count and missing EOS recorded
controls.prelaunch_correction: Broadened random control before any probe training, candidate scoring or benchmark evaluation to match the assignment random-selection requirement.

limitations: Relative teacher-forced loss reduction is a proxy, not verified mathematical correctness or causal data utility.
Random sampling is uniform within the broad prepared source pool after declared shared exclusions, not untouched original100K.
Random targets may be truncated by the shared 8K training cutoff, while complete-target fit is part of advanced selection; report this rate and do not attribute all gains to transfer scoring.
Separate eligible-random and coverage-only ablations would be needed to isolate transfer gain from eligibility and coverage allocation.
No novelty or state-of-the-art claim is established before results.
